scope: Focused implementation supplement; current source defaults, not a recovered historical run manifest.

offline_extraction.historical_model_provenance: Not verified from an archived run manifest in this release.
offline_extraction.input_unit: Document title followed by all distinct passages sharing that title.
offline_extraction.prompt_limits_enforcement: Prompt instructions; not hard post-validation limits.

json_handling.gemini: JSON MIME type and Pydantic response schema are passed to the provider.
json_handling.vllm_and_qwen_api: JSON instructions plus local schema parsing; no strict response_format schema is sent.
json_handling.local: JSON instructions plus local schema parsing.

offline_extraction.retry_count_scope: The extractor loop has five attempts. Provider adapters or SDKs can retry within each attempt.
offline_extraction.provider_top_p: Not explicitly set in the current adapter.
offline_extraction.thinking: Extraction does not set a Gemini thinking budget. PARM_DISABLE_THINKING can disable thinking for compatible Qwen/vLLM servers.

answer_generation.metrics: Maximum normalized exact match and token F1 over all reference answers, then mean over questions.

2WikiMultihopQA.selection: Lexicographically sort original question IDs, then take sequential subsets.

MuSiQue.selection_in_manuscript: First 1000 questions in original data order.

datasets.historical_question_id_status: Not present in the supplied release source; question_ids.py exports IDs from an existing frozen manifest without resampling.
